- Consistent orientation, front facing +Y
- Correct and consistent pivots / origins
- Maintain exact positioning between different assets
- Separate configurable components where necessary
- Consistent file naming

The geometry does not yet need to be fully optimized during Phase 1.

### Phase 2 – Full web optimization
**Deadline: November 3, 2026**

We preferably want the same freelancer to also complete Phase 2:

- Strong polygon reduction / low-poly optimization
- Remove invisible and unne

title: Dark Fantasy Superhero Novel
desc:
I already hold a detailed AI-generated prompt that maps out the plot, characters, and worldbuilding for a fantasy-based, dark-and-gritty superhero saga driven by an anti-hero lead. What I now need is an established author who can translate that skeleton into a living, breathing novel—something unmistakably human in voice, emotion, and craft.

You would take my document and expand it into a full-length, one-of-a-kind manuscript that I can publish and sell under my name. Expect morally gray choices, sweeping yet shadow-soaked set pieces, and a protagonist whose powers are matched only by their inner turmoil. I’m aiming for a true page-turner that balances cinematic action with layered character work.

Deliverables  
• Complete novel manuscript (80–100k words or the natural length the story demands)  
• Brief synopsis and back-cover blurb suitable for marketing  
• Chapter titles and a clean table of contents  
• One round of revisions after my detailed feedback  
• Final, polished file in both Word and PDF, with all rights transferred to me upon payment  

Proper pacing, natural dialogue, and fresh, vivid prose are essential; genre tropes are welcome only when they feel earned. If you have prior fantasy or superhero credits, let me know—the darker and more character-driven, the better.

Timeline and milestones are flexible as long as quality remains paramount. Let’s craft a masterpiece together.

2. Improved positions for niche academic keywords we agree on at kickoff.  
3. Traffic quality metrics—time on page, pages per session—consistent with real student/teacher interest.

title: Illustrative Logo Design With Abstract Shapes
desc:
I’m developing a lifestyle-focused personal blog and want a logo that instantly signals creativity and freshness. The direction is illustrative rather than purely typographic or minimalistic, and I picture clean, modern lines built around abstract shapes that feel dynamic without becoming busy. Colour and typography choices should reinforce a warm yet contemporary vibe and hold up equally well on Instagram posts, website headers, business cards, and larger print pieces.

Here’s how I’d like the process to run: start by presenting two-to-three distinct concept sketches so I can react to overall mood, palette, and composition. Once we lock in a favourite, we’ll fine-tune spacing, colour variations, and any tag-line placement through a round or two of revisions until it feels spot-on.

For hand-off, I’ll need:
• High-resolution PNG and JPG in both full-colour and monochrome versions  
• A scalable vector/source file (AI, EPS or SVG) with fonts either outlined or included  
• A brief style guide noting colour codes and typography so the look stays consistent across future assets

If you have questions about the brand voice or want to suggest unexpected abstract motifs, just let me know—creative input is welcome as long as the final mark remains clean, modern, and unmistakably mine.

title: Cinematic AI Movie Video Editor
desc:
I’m putting together a story-driven AI movie and I need an editor who can elevate the raw, model-generated footage into a polished cinematic experience. The core of the job revolves around three creative pillars:  

• Special effects that merge seamlessly with the AI-rendered scenes  
• Rich, film-style color grading that reinforces mood and atmosphere  
• Detailed sound design to anchor every beat of the narrative  

You’ll receive pre-rendered sequences (4K, 24 fps), prompt notes, reference clips, and the dialogue stems. I’m open to whichever professional suite you work fastest in—Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci, or a comparable tool—so long as you can deliver:  

1. A locked picture edit approved via timestamped review links  
2. Full SFX and ambience layers delivered as separate stems  
3. A final 4K master (ProRes or DNxHR) plus a lightly compressed H.264 for online viewing  

I’ll review rough cuts, VFX passes, and the final grade against these acceptance criteria: frame-accurate effects integration, consistent LUT application across scenes, and balanced audio that peaks no higher than –6 dB. Timelines are flexible within reason, but clear communication and regular progress updates are essential.  

If you thrive on cinematic storytelling and love pushing AI footage to the next level, let’s talk and set our first milestone.

If you’re ready to pick up the phone and start closing, let’s talk and set a start date.
